planning_basis: Planner-owned decomposition rebuilt after the explicit Admin reset and v155 baseline import. README defines product requirements and governance; roadmap phases, order, architecture, decomposition and release prerequisites remain Planner-owned below Admin and README authority.
core_rule: Player advises -> AI Character decides -> Simulation validates -> World reacts.

baseline.public_policy: The stable public URL may serve an Admin-directed unverified development build when explicitly authorized. Independent Tester verification remains required before a build or phase is described as independently verified under normal autonomous progression.

phase_policy.map_rule: Every cumulative phase must preserve and progressively extend the persistent living strategic world map as the primary playable surface rather than replacing it with disconnected dashboards, static mockups or menu-only presentation.
phase_policy.designer_rule: Every phase requires at least one independently testable Graphic Designer task before normal phase completion.
phase_policy.normal_phase_transition_rule: Under normal autonomous progression, the dedicated Tester must independently pass the active phase gate before the next phase activates. Explicit Admin instructions may override normal publication or phase/release workflow requirements without converting unverified work into verified work.

REUSE: Admin-selected v155 WebGL/isometric strategic map as the current development baseline
camera pan, zoom and inertial navigation
tile picking, hover, selection and non-authoritative inspection
roads, settlements, minimap and compatible localization
compatible textures, terrain rendering and current organic elevation work
ADAPT: binding double-click/double-tap protagonist movement so map interaction preserves character autonomy
authoritative-state boundaries inherited from the legacy map generator
legacy menu, tool or wording patterns that imply direct command authority
legacy subordinate technical documentation that attempts to override README or Planner-approved architecture/decomposition
DEFER: legacy or imported economy, progression, faction, campaign, AI or other gameplay behavior not required by the current active phase
future autonomous Local BOT and optional LLM character decision systems beyond current state/persistence work
REJECT: legacy rules that override Admin or README authority
runtime behavior that gives the player binding direct control over the autonomous protagonist
visual assets or presentation state acting as authoritative simulation truth by themselves
hidden nondeterministic inputs controlling authoritative outcomes

phases.title: Strategic World Baseline Reconciliation and Stabilization
phases.completion: Dedicated Tester PHASE GATE PASS on current compatible descendant 893a38aec36c5e7a5b616d7968481a776aa3edd0; tracker and gate closed completed.

phases.title: Authoritative World and Campaign State
phases.release_gate: Establish deterministic simulation-owned campaign/world state, seeded reproducibility and cumulative versioned save/load behavior while the living strategic map remains the primary surface; independent phase verification required before R03.

phases.title: Legal Action Validation
phases.release_gate: Add deterministic simulation-owned legality validation without player result injection or direct action execution; expose consequences through the living map and pass independent phase verification before R04.

phases.title: Autonomous Local BOT Core
phases.release_gate: Add the deterministic local character driver so the protagonist chooses actions within simulation constraints and the living world visibly reflects validated movement/state; independent phase verification required before R05.

phases.title: Conversation and Advisor Influence
phases.release_gate: Add natural advisor-character interaction and influence boundaries without binding direct control, integrated with the same living strategic world; independent phase verification required before R06.

phases.title: Memory, Trust and Relationships
phases.release_gate: Add persistent character memory, trust and relationship effects that influence autonomous decisions and are reflected coherently in the cumulative world; independent phase verification required before R07.

phases.title: Advisor Instruction Plain-Text System
phases.release_gate: Add structured human-readable persistent Advisor Instructions as an influence system, never as direct authority over simulation truth; independent phase verification required before R08.

phases.title: Optional LLM Adapter and Deterministic Fallback
phases.release_gate: Add an optional LLM driver for the same protagonist with privacy-conscious context boundaries and deterministic Local BOT fallback; authoritative simulation and living-map behavior remain intact; independent phase verification required before R09.

phases.title: Peasant Survival and Local Economy
phases.release_gate: Extend the living map with meaningful local survival, work, resources, locations and relationships appropriate to early-rank authority; independent phase verification required before R10.

phases.title: Squire and Knight Progression
phases.release_gate: Add rank-appropriate training, patronage, duties, missions and progression while maintaining autonomous character choice and spatial world continuity; independent phase verification required before R11.

phases.title: Settlements, Factions, Trade and Diplomacy
phases.release_gate: Expand settlements, factions, economy, trade and diplomacy as simulation-backed systems represented through the living strategic world; independent phase verification required before R12.

phases.title: Court, Realm Economy, Military and Succession
phases.release_gate: Add higher-rank court, realm economy, strategic military and succession systems without direct unit-by-unit player control; independent phase verification required before R13.

phases.title: King, Multi-Kingdom and Emperor Endgame
phases.release_gate: Extend authoritative simulation and living-world presentation to sovereign and imperial scale while preserving character autonomy and readable causality; independent phase verification required before R14.

phases.title: Advanced Advisor Tools and Mini-Games
phases.release_gate: Add direct Advisor tools and mini-games that improve information or influence without bypassing character autonomy or simulation authority; independent phase verification required before R15.

phases.title: Presentation, Accessibility, Balance and Campaign Release
phases.release_gate: Complete cumulative presentation, accessibility, responsiveness, balance, performance and campaign-level regression across the living strategic world and obtain dedicated Tester verification for the final normal release state.
